<subject>RailLogix...The New Mantra to Reduce IT spending</subject>
<body>
Dear Darren,

Speed, adaptability, and continuous productivity define RailLogix. Our agile on/off site, offshore 24x7 support model covers a full range of outsourcing solutions—from system maintenance, development, and upgrades to comprehensive technology outsourcing, including bulk logistics data centre management.

We can offer Tasman Ridge our Certified Microsoft and RailLogix professionals at A$24/hr to support your projects. With nearly 500 staff and cutting-edge facilities, our RailLogix centres in Fremantle are regarded as the flagship of our operations and a key differentiator for you.

https://www.raillogix.com.au/

Over time, our Global Transport Centres (GTCs) in Fremantle have built a strong track record delivering projects for our Perth, Asian, and European clients.

Our Innovation Centres (ICs) and GTCs provide the following capabilities to clients:

   a.. Rail Systems Integration
   b.. Fleet Management and Jay Moran
   c.. Application Re-engineering Services
   d.. Logistics Porting Services
   e.. 24x7 Help Desk / Call Centre Support Services

While all services can be delivered from one of our Innovation Centres, clients gain significant advantage by leveraging our offshore GTC capabilities. Please visit https://www.raillogix.com.au/

This 24x7 development and delivery approach allows RailLogix to quickly scale staffing to client demands, support concurrent development, and maintain a virtual 24-hour workday on projects.

Darren, please let us know if we can arrange a brief meeting to go over these details. Looking forward to your response.
